job.purpose: q13b-kvend: ot_qkvd_fbuf8p = fbuf8 with the pop pin registered once per slice inside the tile (every face pin registered; kv_end PQ=2 child). M5 leaf contract.

benches.name: fbuf8p_d8
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -DFBUF8 -s tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p -P tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p.D=8 -o {RUN}/bench/fbuf8p_d8 rtl/test/qwen_kv_die/tb_qkvd_buf_tile_p.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_buf_tiles.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sl.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_d2d.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo_sb.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2.v && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/fbuf8p_d8 | tee {RUN}/bench/fbuf8p_d8.log && grep -q "^PASS" {RUN}/bench/fbuf8p_d8.log
